description: Get a shipping quote by shippingQuoteId with its rates, package, addresses, and expiry (Logistics API getShippingQuote). Logistics API is limited release (eBay-approved developers only, USPS rates and labels only) and needs the https://api.ebay.com/oauth/api_scope/sell.logistics scope, which is not requested by default: eligible keysets add it to EBAY_OAUTH_SCOPES and re-consent.

shippingQuoteId.description: Shipping quote ID returned by ebay_create_shipping_quote

name: ebay_get_shipping_quote
